candidates.target_route: Input bytes F9 7E 00 decode as a CBOR half-precision NaN. Float construction preserves NaN; to_cbor emits a double-precision float; the second from_cbor decodes it as NaN; the entry compares the two JSON values.
candidates.failure_condition: The equality operator compares stored floats with ==, so the two NaN values compare unequal and the existing assertion fails.
